diagram_previews.alt: A plus-shaped cross made of five unit squares: a central square with one square attached to each of its four sides.

Part of the cross: the central square C, the arms N (above) and E (right) shaded, the other two arms grey, and the missing corner square between N and E dotted. A red segment joins P in N to Q in E and crosses the dashed line x = 1 above the corner, passing through the missing square; dotted lines mark P's distances u and s from the lines x = 1 and y = 1, and Q's distances t and v.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the reduction to adjacent arms and the observation that the exit condition becomes st > uv for four independent uniform variables, which has probability 1/2 by symmetry.
